english.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the physical surface of the Earth.
Use this for the ground or land surface, rather than an indoor floor or a building storey.
Use this when “deck” means the ground or floor that someone falls or lies on.

examples.english: The ground is still wet after the rain.
examples.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 dei6 min6 zung6 mei6 gon1

examples.english: When hiking, the forest floor is very slippery.
examples.traditional: 行山嗰陣，森林嘅地面好跣。
examples.jyutping: haang4 saan1 go2 zan6 sam1 lam4 ge3 dei6 min6 hou2 sin2
keoi5 dit3 zo2 hai2 dei6 min6 dou6
